title: Visual target
description: Click a seeded target in a custom-drawn canvas with no element-level semantics.

title: Semantic disambiguation
description: Choose one of two identically labelled controls using its surrounding panel.

title: Order search
description: Search a seeded order table and open the exact matching record.

title: Structured form
description: Create a user with exact text, select, and checkbox values.

title: Preferences
description: Update a select and two switches to a seeded target configuration.

title: Scroll and select
description: Find and select a seeded item initially outside a scroll container's viewport.

title: Drag and drop
description: Move a seeded card between Kanban columns using a real pointer drag.

title: Wait and dialog
description: Start one delayed operation, wait for a modal, and choose the requested outcome exactly once.

title: Cross-tab code
description: Open a new tab, read a seeded code, return to the original tab, and submit it.

title: File roundtrip
description: Upload the provided fixture, start processing, wait, and download the generated result.
